items.en_title: Bozano (RS) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 30 #0003
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Bozano (RS) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 5; proposals close Nov 30, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
